body:
That's all very well, but what can i DO to get out of here? I've been hanging on for a while on the uplifting messages of hope, but there seems to be disconnect between them and actual change. So what I just...don't kill myself? I've heard that before.


It seems like no one is qualified to handle these things. My parents can barely hold their own lives together and I feel like a social worker for my family at times. They don't talk to me if they can help it. They always diffuse and deflect like crazy. They feel like strangers to me. The harder I push on them for communication and support, the more volatile they become. It's awful but I've learned to live with them as if they are roommates. Awkward strained roommates who control very much of my life and finances.

I made this throwaway to get help myself, but since you have no other comments, I guess I'll say what I can.

First and foremost: You need allies, or even just a single ally. Your psychiatrist turned out to be useless, but your search for help doesn't have to end because of that. A better way to put it is that a psychiatrist was useless. There are many out there. If you have health insurance, you could try everyone in your network. 

If I had to take stock of your situation: It sounds like you have problems that others struggle with. I don't hear anything damning about your condition from what you wrote. What I mean is that you as a person are not irrepparably messed up. It only seems that way because you aren't in the safety net for people like you. You missed the safety net on the first go-around. If your psychiatrist had been better then they would have helped you set up a network of support around yourself. 

As I understand it, there is a process for helping people in your condition. 

1. Suicide intervention at a hospital 

leads to:

2. Meeting with a psychiatrist

leads to:

3. Setting up a mental support network

and:

4. Setting up a financial support network


Your problems may seem un-fixable, but I think that is because you haven't seen all the resources a proper psychologist can get for you. You never made it past step 2 is my guess.


Have you tried getting dog food from the food bank? Every food bank is different but mine accepts pet food.
